summary: Structure Therapeutics Inc. filed a prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 to increase the maximum aggregate offering amount under an existing at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement to $400 million. The filing updates a prior ATM prospectus dated August 6, 2025, and removes the previous offering limit. As of the filing, approximately $58.5 million (3,040,000 ADSs) had been sold, with remaining capacity of about $341.5 million. ADSs trade on Nasdaq under symbol GPCR. The sales agents (Leerink Partners and Cantor Fitzgerald) receive up to 3.0% commission. This is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special situation.
